identity.title: [v0.92.1][runtime][observatory] Wire trusted Observatory origin into CSM launch config

values.summary: Bind current main, transplant only the trusted-origin follow-up, harden exact-origin parsing, make the HTML Observatory trust the configured Wuji Runtime host, make the health endpoint obey the same configured-origin CORS policy as the other Observatory reads, add executable tests, retain live browser proof, obtain fresh review, and publish one closing PR.

steps.action: Bind issue #550 from current main and transplant only the trusted-origin follow-up delta.
Harden exact public-origin validation and add executable valid and invalid generation tests.
Make the HTML Observatory trusted Runtime host config-owned and prove the configured Wuji host is accepted while arbitrary hosts fail.
Apply the configured-origin CORS policy to Runtime health and prove the real Observatory three-endpoint connection.
Run focused local validation and retain bounded live Wuji trusted-TLS and CORS evidence.
Obtain fresh exact-head review, fix all findings, publish, shepherd green checks, merge, finish, and clean.

invariants: Invalid input cannot replace generated Runtime config
The HTML Observatory does not trust arbitrary Runtime v3 hosts
HOT-01 remains the sole dynamic-reload owner
risks: Shell parsing could accept path or credential syntax
A port outside the valid TCP range could pass shallow validation
Static source assertions could falsely pass without executing generation
A stale hard-coded HTML trusted host could reject the live Wuji runtime
Transplanting the old branch could delete newer main work
stop_conditions: The delta expands beyond the three declared source/docs/test files
Current main cannot be preserved cleanly
Fresh review finds unresolved actionable issues
